en: Colorized panoramic view of a small European town surrounded by fields and low hills. The foreground shows a park-like green area with paths and leafless trees. Along intersecting roads stand several multi‑storey townhouses and civic buildings with red or green roofs, as well as an industrial chimney to the right. The scene is printed in an old lithographic style. At the top center appears the caption 'Seifhennersdorf — Mitteldorf.' and at the upper left the word 'Gemeindeamt.'
